refnamediv.refpurpose: Broker a local application's protected read to a remote verifier

refsect1.title: Description
refsect1.para: The socket activates a broker instance for each connection. The caller must be the configured UID in an eligible local logind session. The broker obtains a challenge from the configured verifier, requests contextual PAM verification through platformd-verifyd, and sends matching TPM evidence from platformd-trustd to the verifier. The relying service authorizes the read. The PAM declaration retains its root-declared evidence quality.

The local Varlink interface is io.platformd.Attest at /run/platformd-attestd/io.platformd.Attest. Read requires more and accepts the protected-read profile. Intermediate replies convey informational verification messages. The final result contains the resource or an error. attestctl read writes the resource to standard output and verification messages to standard error.

The optional platformd-attest-viewer requests the same profile when a document is opened. It renders the authorized result as UTF-8 plain text. Cancelling the request or closing the window disconnects from the broker. The viewer does not save the document to disk.

refsect1.title: Configuration
refsect1.para: /etc/platformd/attestd.conf must be owned by root and readable only by root. Configure one [Verifier] section with these settings:

listitem.para: The authorized nonzero numeric UID. Set SocketGroup= in a socket unit drop-in to a group accessible by that UID.
Absolute HTTPS endpoint and exact audience accepted from that verifier. The challenge and completion use one TLS connection.
Lowercase SHA-256 identifier of the enrolled attestation key and a printable verifier label used for the verification request.

Absolute paths to root-owned PEM files and the server public-key pin in sha256// form. Keep the private key accessible only to root. The connection uses mutually authenticated TLS 1.3 with server name validation.
Set to yes to authorize disclosure of the global retained runtime history to this verifier. The broker requires explicit authorization for this disclosure.
